operations.label: Go To Menu — Go To Button (portal-frame iframe)
operations.summary: Employee Search panel's "Go To" dropdown inside the portal-frame iframe render.
operations.note: Same slide-out scoping as goToButtonOnPage but takes a FrameLocator argument. NEEDS LIVE RE-VERIFY 2026-06-22.

operations.label: Click Go To Dropdown
operations.summary: Employee Search panel's "Go To" dropdown at the top-level page render.
operations.note: Primary: #goToDropdownButton scoped to .quick-find-content — avoids timecard toolbar 'Go to' button that sits behind slideout mask (live error 2026-06-22)

operations.label: Click Timecard Option in Go To Menu
operations.summary: Timecard menu item in the open Go To dropdown.
operations.note: Anchored name /^\s*timecards?\s*$/i — bare /timecard/i substring matched 'Employee timecards' page-title after first doc (2026-06-24). clickGoToTimecard polls timecardItem.first().waitFor with 15s deadline + one dropdown re-open retry

operations.label: WFD Loading Overlay
operations.summary: WFD full-page loading overlay — wait for it to be hidden before clicking.
operations.note: CSS multi-selector: .wfd-loading-overlay, [data-wfd-loading], .wfd-modal-overlay, .wfd-busy-indicator. Used as a wait/probe (waitFor hidden) before clicks; not directly interacted with. NEEDS LIVE RE-VERIFY 2026-06-17.

operations.label: Open Employee Search Sidebar
operations.summary: Open the Employee Search sidebar.

operations.label: Close Employee Search Sidebar
operations.summary: Close the Employee Search sidebar.
operations.note: Called before verifyTimecardEmployee — closes slide-out so EID text on the open timecard is readable

operations.label: Select Employee (check first result)
operations.summary: First result's "Select Item" checkbox — checking it selects the employee, enabling the Go To button.
operations.note: selectEmployeeResult(). Enables the Go To button. Do NOT union with 'Select All' header checkbox

operations.label: Wait for Search Result (found detection)
operations.note: resolveSearchResult races firstResultCheckbox (attached) vs firstResultSlat (visible) vs noResultsText vs 15s timeout. Timeout → not-found + log.warn (never throws)

operations.label: Search — First Result Row (fallback)
operations.summary: First result row fallback — menuitemradio or row[role=row]; clicking also selects the employee.
operations.note: .or() fallback chain: getByRole('menuitemradio') or locator('[role=row]') .first(). Accepts SearchRoot.

operations.label: Search — First Result Slat (found probe)
operations.summary: First result SLAT — a "somebody showed up" signal for found-detection.
operations.note: Kept TIGHT (no [role=row] fallback) so a header/placeholder row cannot false-positive a not-found search into found. Used in Promise.any([...]) race with firstResultCheckbox for found-detection in resolveSearchResult. NEEDS LIVE RE-VERIFY 2026-06-22.

operations.label: Search — No Results Text
operations.summary: "There are no items to display" text — no-results probe.
operations.note: Used to detect empty search results via waitFor. Probed in a race against firstResultCheckbox/firstResultSlat in resolveSearchResult.

operations.label: Fill Employee Search Input
operations.summary: Search textbox — accepts employee name or ID; resolved iframe-or-top-level.
operations.accessibleName: Search by Employee Name or ID
operations.note: SearchRoot = FrameLocator | Page (portal-frame iframe OR top-level page — resolveSearchRoot handles both)

operations.label: Search — Employee Name/ID Input (scrape)
operations.summary: Read current value of the employee search textbox.
operations.accessibleName: Search by Employee Name or ID
operations.note: Accepts SearchRoot (FrameLocator | Page). See fill variant for iframe/page duality note.

operations.label: Click Employee Search Submit
operations.summary: Search submit button (exact name to distinguish from other Search buttons).
operations.note: getByRole with exact:true to avoid matching other Search-named buttons on the page.

operations.label: Search Frame (portal-frame iframe)
operations.summary: Grab the Employee Search sidebar iframe with a dynamic session-dependent name.
operations.note: Returns a FrameLocator (not a Locator); used as the SearchRoot context for all search selectors. iframe name suffix changes each session (name^="portal-frame-"). Inferred scrape kind — this is a container/context provider, not a directly interactive element.

operations.label: Navigate to New Kronos (WFD)
operations.summary: Opens New Kronos Dayforce login page

operations.label: Click Apply (date range)
operations.summary: Apply button for the custom date range.

operations.label: Timecard — Calendar Day Cell
operations.summary: Moment-picker day cell for a specific date — click to select a day in the range picker.
operations.note: Takes a runtime name param (string | RegExp) matching the full-date aria-label (e.g. 'Monday, June 11, 2026'). .and(td.js-moment-picker-item:not(.out-of-month)) prevents matching adjacent-month trailing days.

operations.label: Timecard — Calendar Month/Year Header
operations.summary: Moment-picker month/year header (e.g. "Jun 2026") — read to know which way to step the calendar.
operations.note: CSS locator: th.js-moment-picker-parent-view .first(). Read its text to determine navigation direction for calendarPrevMonth / calendarNextMonth.

operations.label: Timecard — Calendar Next Month Arrow
operations.summary: Moment-picker "Next month" arrow button.

operations.label: Timecard — Calendar Previous Month Arrow
operations.summary: Moment-picker "Previous month" arrow button.

operations.label: Fill Kronos Date Range End
operations.summary: End date input for custom range — NATIVE <input type=date>, value as ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
operations.note: Targeted by id #endDateTimeInput. Same fill rules as startDateInput: ISO only, no masked typing.

operations.label: Timecard — End Date Input (scrape)
operations.summary: Read the current end date value from the custom range input.
operations.note: Value is ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Targeted by id #endDateTimeInput.

operations.label: Open Pay Period Selector
operations.summary: Pay-period trigger button — text varies ("Current Pay Period", "Previous Pay Period", or a date range).
operations.note: Regex name matches current, previous, or date-range display. .first() in case multiple match.

operations.label: Timecard — Previous Pay Period Option
operations.summary: Previous Pay Period option inside an open period dropdown.

operations.label: Click Select Range (custom date range)
operations.summary: "Select range" button to switch to custom date range.

operations.label: Fill Kronos Date Range Start
operations.summary: Start date input for custom range — NATIVE <input type=date>, value as ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
operations.note: Native <input type=date>; value MUST be ISO YYYY-MM-DD via fill() — MM/DD/YYYY is silently dropped (reverts to today). computeKronosDateRange(lastDayWorked, separationDate) ±1 month

operations.label: Timecard — Start Date Input (scrape)
operations.summary: Read the current start date value from the custom range input.
operations.note: Value is ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Targeted by id #startDateTimeInput.

operations.label: Assert Open Timecard Belongs to Searched EID
operations.summary: verifyTimecardEmployee polls timecard page text for the searched EID; THROWS when timecard shows a different employee (stale Go To left previous employee's timecard)
operations.note: Live bug 2026-06-24: search 10603110 → Yang/10832819 still displayed. Throw is non-fatal in settled parallel block (logged + fallback to Kuali dates)

operations.label: Scrape Holiday Pay Dates
operations.summary: getSeparationTimecardData() — Holiday-Hourly rows from timecard grid; chronological MM/DD/YYYY list
operations.note: When both sick and holiday present: only the latest (the one that sets separationDate) appears in the comment clause

operations.label: Scrape Last Physical Punch Date
operations.summary: getSeparationTimecardData() parses .ui-grid-viewport rows for In/Out punches; lastPunchDate = latest date with an In or Out entry
operations.note: Virtual-scroll grid — only on-screen rows in DOM; screenshot uses centerSelector+viewport (not fullPage). null when no punch found

operations.label: Scrape Sick Leave Dates
operations.summary: getSeparationTimecardData() — Sick-Hourly rows from timecard grid; chronological MM/DD/YYYY list
operations.note: Extends separationDate AND drives leave clause in buildTerminationComments
